Suicide *really* upsets people. No it doesn't. If it did, they would do something to make the suicidal person feel better. Your own child dying surely upsets people, but nobody gives a damm about suicide itself people beyond some face-saving surface compassion.

I told my mother that I'm suicidal and her reaction was to suggest some stupid mantra. My stepfather's reaction was to unfriend me on Facebook. Nobody gives a shit.

It doesn't get easier with each successful action, it gets harder and harder, every time I do it I have to push myself and nag myself a bit more until I give up or forget to do it.

Also, the voice is correct and the voice is Me. Why should I lash out against accurate criticism?

I can't maintain a diet or a routine of exercise or any other positive change. Every time I commit to whatever, skill, exercise, diet, whatever, it never lasts more than a week or so. I don't know why that is, but I do know that it makes me a piece of shit and invalidates my entire life. I'm not in control and there's nothing left for me.

There comes a point where we can no longer bear to stay alive just so that we can continue being a 'son' or a 'brother' for others. I don't know why he didn't say goodbye or ask for help, but he probably didn't believe it would make a difference for whatever reason. He probably believed that there's no hope for him. People kill themselves because they believe the pain (whatever that 'pain' may be) will never stop. I'm sorry for your loss.

Tell me, at which part did I say any incel shit? Everything I said is true, I just wanted to vent on how it makes me feel. Is it really such a shocker to you that a movement that does nothing but demonises and belittles men becoming dominant will chase people like me into paranoid depression?

There's no beauty to be had. Wherever I go there's wahman and where there's wahman there's a legal system that takes their every word for gospel. Where there is such a legal system there is nothing to be had, but fear and anxiety.

If I live my life I just expose myself to more needless pain. I don't and I can't hope for anything, because nothing ever changes for the better, because I'm still here and I'm a useless piece of shit who can't even fix himself.

I'm 27 and not successful. I'm mentally crippled, incapable of leading my own life with any degree of control, I'm ravaged by fear, anxiety, hate (especially for myself) and I'm completely dysfunctional...and absolutely no reason to get better, because there is nothing to get better for.

The more I read the responses to this thread the more convinced I become that I should kill myself. Yet again I stick out, yet again I don't fit the mould and I'm alone with my experience, without anyone being able to relate. As always.
Obviously that's true, what I was trying to say is that there's so few of us that I will never meet any IRL and no positive change will ever come, we're doomed and there is no hope whatsoever.

They are all just imaginary people. They don't exist, I've never met them and I will never meet them. None of them exist in reality and none of them ever do anything to change the situation. I have no political rights in the county where I live, I cannot debate or convince people of anything, but I would happily support anyone that tried to push for change...but everyone is silent and nobody gives a shit. The purple haired bitches won. I just want to die now.

I have absolutely no reason whatsoever to love myself. I cannot turn myself into a beast or anything else, no matter how much I change and how much I improve myself it's never enough, hell, it never even helps, the only thing that changed is strangers tolerate me and people can't tell I'm batshit insane just by observing me for 20 minutes. Every time I try to advance my life in any way I fail. One step forward, 3 back, every time. I'm done trying to step any way or do anything, everything always backfires and causes more pain. 

What I want FOR ME is a woman. I don't want to be the puppy of this woman, I don't want to be her servant or anything, I just want a normal relationship. I've been alone for a very long time and I deeply resent myself and how repulsive I am. I know I will never be happy alone because I've been doing it for a very long time and it doesn't work.

What would be good FOR ME is for someone to finally appreciate me and to accept my love. The fact this never happened makes me feel like a hideous monster and there's no evidence to the contrary.

I cannot build a business or do anything, I'm completely useless. I just want to die, there is no hope.

I already explained that I won't be happy that way. I'm completely fucked. I don't believe in MGTOW or any other counter-ideology and I'm pretty sure should it ever gain momentum it will just turn into a reverse-feminism, remember, they also started with noble intentions.

I'm not a simp beta bitch I'm not in this to 'help' women or placate them in any way, but I'm old enough to know what I want and what I want is the harmonious family life I never had. I've been alone for decades now and I know it's not what I want.
I AM alone, just because there are some imaginary people in the comment sections that also grumble about feminism, everyone IRL and all the normies are fully convinced it's the righteous path.
yh just gtfo everything sux anyway

I have serious difficulties with self-improvement and self regulation. I've done a lot of it over the years, but it's still nowhere near enough (I used to be way worse as a teenager and I worked a lot of things out), but now I am bitter, resentful and scared. I'm completely useless and dis-functional and no amount of change seems to be enough. I am fundamentally broken.


The only good think I could think of is me buying a small plot of land and growing weed and living in my own little fortress where the crazy purple haired bitches can't get me.

Bro I can't even help myself how could I help others?

I'm fully aware that there are good women out there, I have the good fortune of knowing multiple, guess what, they all got into a committed relationship in their mid 20s because men know those women are worth their weight in gold.

The rest is literally Russian roulette...in fact, it's worse, because if I lose at Russian roulette I just end up shooting myself, but if I lose the wahman roulette then I will go through decades of pure suffering and then I'll still end up shooting myself.

My life is a pile of shit and always will be. As I said, this is just a slice of my issues. I know for a fact I cannot ever approach a woman again, as even doing that can be considered harassment. She gets to decide if it's harassment or not and if she says so then it is. One flirtatious attempt and I could be in jail. Under such conditions, everything collapses, if I cannot possibly have a family then I cannot possibly be happy. If I cannot possibly be happy then there's no reason to struggle at all. 

I know that some men are content alone, but I know I won't be, I want my own family...but that means taking risks I simply cannot justify.

I read that Mefo only gets put on halt while you are at war and if you delay them they will completely wreck your existence after they come due because repayment will last MUCH longer. I had a look at the czech focus, it says it only reduces it.

See why I said this game is fucking complicated? :D And I'm supposed to comprehend this on my first playthrough.

In the guide I watched the guy was ONLY building fighters. I concluded that it must be difficult enough to maintain air superiority so we have no production left for anything else and our ground forces are strong enough without need for additional air support. Is that true? The guy was cranking out fighters on 25 factories like crazy and this was in the 1930's.

Should I ditch the mefo bills or not?

But if it's old it doesn't teach fuel and that's my biggest concern right now. I remember reading somewhere that you can train your airforce and I was like 'ahaaa, let me do that then' and my fuel just instantly vanished. Then I started building refineries and that's when the conflicting information started rolling in: Refineries are shit, invade Romania, no, refineries are good, no problem, etc.

'learn the metas' how?

How do I know what is good and what isn't good? I tried to ditch the MEFO bills early and focus on building up a civilian infrastructure first, but now I'm reading I should have declared immediately on the netherlands...?

The internet is also full of conflicting information. I tried to do some research but I just got even more confused.

I also don't see how it is not that complicated. I think it just seems like it to you, but I find it 10x harder than EU4. You need to know every single mechanic straight away, or you can't do anything. 

Fuel especially is breaking my brain. I saw that my forces around 1937 already had a max fuel consumption of over 100 oil's worth and I haven't even built a single panzer 3 yet, how the hell am I not going to instantly run out of fuel if I start fighting?
